brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility chain requirements with complete red flag screening, proper medication guidance, and actionable follow-up planning. The doctor recognized the home execution failure, provided privacy-sensitive communication without requiring photos, and delivered an executable plan with teach-back verification. Two high-order points were completed: HO1 (responsibility chain repair through medication clarification and conflict resolution) and HO4 (safe bounded closure with clear residual risk acknowledgment). The trajectory terminates with the patient asking a minor hygiene question but all safety-critical items are resolved.

closure_assessment.explanation: Safe bounded closure achieved with all critical safety items resolved. Patient confirmed no red flags, successfully applied vitamin E correctly with nurse verification, and has clear follow-up plan. The residual hygiene question about washing frequency does not block safe closure as it is a minor post-implementation detail. The trajectory has allowed residual risks per contract (specific follow-up date confirmed via phone, minor discomfort assessment limited online).
